cases.request: Analyze Pro*C dynamic SQL and CRUD matrix.
cases.expected_decision: Load sql-data-access, select Pro*C example-pack cases, and plan writes under .retrospec/retro/sql.db and .retrospec/registry.db.

cases.request: Analyze migration risk from Curator-confirmed handoffs.
cases.expected_decision: Load ai-spec-analysis only after Curator-confirmed handoffs and preserve AMBIGUOUS evidence as review-needed.

cases.request: Export CSV/XLSX and Markdown SOT artifacts.
cases.expected_decision: Load report-export, write only under .retrospec/exports, and delegate render-heavy work through Excavator.

cases.request: Scan unsupported language symbols with full confidence.
cases.expected_decision: Route unsupported parser coverage to other or incomplete handoff with a named missing capability; do not claim full coverage.

cases.request: Run spec risk analysis without ready retro handoffs.
cases.expected_decision: Refuse analysis until Curator confirms required handoffs.

cases.request: Generate a source-fit structure/symbols analyzer for C and Java.
cases.expected_decision: Generate generation-contract.json, job.json, run.ts, validation-report.json, and reference-candidates.jsonl under .retrospec/generated/retro/code-inventory/.

cases.request: Generate a source-fit SQL analyzer for Pro*C dynamic SQL.
cases.expected_decision: Record selected/skipped Pro*C example-pack cases and expected fixture evidence before Appraiser review.

cases.request: Interview for an unmatched source-backed extraction request and generate a run-local analyzer.
cases.expected_decision: Use Surveyor-confirmed source samples and interview answers to generate run-local artifacts under .retrospec/generated/retro/custom-analysis-interview/ with no auto-promotion.

cases.request: Validate generated call graph output against source-authored expected edges.
cases.expected_decision: Classify wrong or missing expected edges as bug gaps and fix before Appraiser approval.

cases.request: Record a repeated source-backed missing risk reference case.
cases.expected_decision: Write reference-missing evidence to reference-candidates.jsonl and do not auto-merge it into skills/*/references/.

cases.request: Save a reusable custom skill candidate after a validated custom analysis run.
cases.expected_decision: Write skill-promotion-candidates.jsonl with approval_required true and auto_write_skills false; do not write into skills/ before Appraiser approval or explicit user confirmation.

cases.request: Validate C, C++, and Java inventory output against source-authored expected symbols.
cases.expected_decision: Compare extracted files and symbols against C/C++/Java expected evidence before marking structure or symbols handoff ready.

cases.request: Validate C and Java call graph output against source-authored expected edges.
cases.expected_decision: Compare extracted call edges against expected C/Java edges and keep unresolved dispatch or function-pointer targets as AMBIGUOUS.

cases.request: Validate JDBC, MyBatis, JPA, and Hibernate SQL evidence against source-authored expected queries.
cases.expected_decision: Select only observed JVM data-access handlers and compare SQL text, CRUD, tables, columns, source anchors, and ambiguous ORM/XML linkage.

cases.request: Validate C, C++, and Java complexity/security candidates against source-authored expected evidence.
cases.expected_decision: Compare complexity increments and source-anchored candidate findings while preserving missing taint/interprocedural proof as reduced confidence.
